name: Paroxetine
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

key_interactions.drug_or_class: MAO inhibitors (including linezolid and IV methylene blue), within 14 days
QT-prolonging drugs that are CYP2D6 substrates (thioridazine, pimozide)
key_interactions.effect: Higher levels and more QT prolongation (label).

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Other serotonergic drugs (SSRIs, SNRIs, triptans, tricyclics, opioids, lithium, buspirone, St John's wort)
key_interactions.action: Monitor; stop if serotonin syndrome occurs.
Warn the patient; monitor INR with warfarin.

key_interactions.effect: Paroxetine is a strong CYP2D6 inhibitor and raises their exposure (label).
key_interactions.action: Decrease the substrate dose if needed.

key_interactions.effect: Lower endoxifen levels and reduced tamoxifen efficacy (label).
key_interactions.action: Consider an antidepressant with little CYP2D6 inhibition.
